title: Chicken and Veggie Congee
summary: Silky rice porridge with shredded chicken and soft carrot, a classic Chinese first food.

steps.text: Add {rice}, {water} and {ginger} to a pot and bring to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer with the lid slightly open, stirring now and then.
steps.tip: Stir often near the end so the rice does not stick.

steps.text: Add {chicken} and {carrot} and cook until the chicken is done.
Lift out the {ginger}. Shred the chicken finely with two forks and stir it back in.
Stir in {scallion} and cook 1 more minute.
Cool until warm. Serve in a shallow bowl with a spoon.
steps.tip: Porridge stays hot inside; stir and test before serving.

toddlerTips: Leave out salt; the stock gives enough flavour.
Shred chicken into tiny strands, not chunks.
Freeze in muffin trays for single portions.
